title: Eye-friendly theme with high-contrast text across all screens

requirements.text: Update the global CSS custom properties in `frontend/src/index.css` to use a softer, eye-friendly color palette: replace the current parchment/cream background with a slightly warmer but lower-saturation tone (e.g., #f7f3ec or similar), reduce the harshness of dark teal accents by softening them to a muted medium teal, and ensure all foreground/body text colors use dark values with a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against their backgrounds (WCAG AA minimum). The gold accent should be darkened enough to remain legible as text.

quotes: Make the theme eye friendly and keep text visible

acceptanceCriteria: Background colors across all screens are warm but not stark white or harsh — a soft parchment/ivory tone that does not cause glare.
Body text and heading text colors are dark with at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio against their background.
Deep teal accent color is softened/desaturated to reduce eye strain while remaining distinct.
Gold accent text meets minimum contrast when used as label or heading text.
No text appears invisible, near-invisible, or same-color-as-background on any screen.

requirements.text: Audit and fix text color declarations in `QuizScreen.tsx`, `ReviewScreen.tsx`, `ResultsScreen.tsx`, `AdminPanelScreen.tsx`, `TopicBrowserScreen.tsx`, `HistoryScreen.tsx`, `HomeScreen.tsx`, `SubscriptionPlansScreen.tsx`, and `AppHeader.tsx` to ensure every text element (question text, option labels, headings, stat numbers, form labels, menu links) uses a clearly visible, high-contrast color against its background. Replace any instance where text color matches or is too close to the background color — particularly on highlighted/selected states, card surfaces, and header areas.
acceptanceCriteria: All option labels in QuizScreen and ReviewScreen are legible on both selected/highlighted and unselected states.
Correct-answer highlights show dark bold text on the green/teal highlight background (not white-on-white).
Incorrect-answer highlights show clearly readable text on the red/rose highlight background.
Card headings and body copy on HomeScreen, HistoryScreen, and SubscriptionPlansScreen all render in high-contrast dark text.
Form labels, input placeholders, and help text in AdminPanelScreen are clearly legible.
Navigation links in AppHeader dropdown are fully visible against the menu background.
Timer and counter text in QuizScreen is readable at all timer states including the red warning state.

requirements.text: Update `frontend/tailwind.config.js` color token definitions (and any OKLCH values used for primary, foreground, muted, accent, and card tokens) to align with the new eye-friendly palette: use lower-saturation, medium-brightness values for backgrounds and softer but sufficiently dark values for text tokens. Ensure the Tailwind theme tokens are consistent with the CSS custom properties updated in REQ-52 so utility classes like `text-foreground`, `bg-card`, `text-primary`, and `text-muted-foreground` all produce accessible, eye-friendly results.

quotes: Make the theme eye friendly and keep text visible

acceptanceCriteria: Tailwind color tokens for foreground, muted-foreground, and primary-foreground all produce dark readable text.
Background tokens (background, card, popover) produce soft, low-glare surfaces.
The updated tokens are reflected consistently across all screens without needing per-component overrides.
No Tailwind utility class produces invisible or near-invisible text on its paired background.

constraints: Do not change the overall Unani/Islamic manuscript aesthetic — retain the parchment, teal, and gold color family; only adjust saturation/brightness/contrast for readability.
Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
The password gate in AdminPanelScreen.tsx (password: 'Naeem9472') must remain unchanged.
PWA manifest colors (theme_color, background_color) should be updated to match the new palette if changed.
nonGoals: Adding or removing any features or screens.
Changing the layout or component structure of any screen.
